title: Window lease, window-lease/1 (DEC-0062)
description: The estate's hub signs, once per machine, that machine's share of one instance of a spending window: the most its meter may spend in that instance, for at most 24 hours. Signed by a hub key the estate record certifies (DEC-0055), over the RFC 8785 form of the lease without sig (DEC-0043, the register's window-lease/1, DEC-0063). Escalation above a lease is an approval (limit-reached, DEC-0034 OC-6), never a lease field.

leaseId.description: The lease's id: the machine reports it to its hub (records.leases[].leaseId, DEC-0053), over the relay or through machine.report on the hub's own machine, and never in a check-in to an organization server (DEC-0128).

sequence.description: Rises with every lease the hub issues one machine for one scope, window and period; a lease with a sequence at or below the one held, other than the held lease itself, is superseded.

estate.description: The estate whose record certifies the signing hub key (estate-record/1 estate).

estateRevision.description: The estate-record revision the hub followed; a meter that applies an earlier revision refuses the lease until it has the revision.

machine.description: The estate id of the one machine whose meter holds this lease (estate-record machines[].id; never an organization enrollment's device.id, DEC-0128).

scope.description: Whose window: estate (L0), project:<id> (L1) or grant:<id>#<revision>. The organization edition's v4 uses estate only.

window.description: The calendar window of the spend policy (DEC-0037, DEC-0038), in UTC; a week starts on Monday.

period.description: The window instance: YYYY-MM-DD for day, the ISO 8601 week YYYY-Www for week, YYYY-MM for month (FAC-SEM-089 refuses a day or week that does not exist).

amount.description: The machine's whole share of the window instance, a decimal string: a newer lease restates it, never adds to it.

expiresAt.description: After issuedAt and at most 24 hours later, and never after the window instance ends (FAC-SEM-089).

alg.description: The hub key's algorithm: Ed25519 until Fabric records its decision D2 (ES256 beside EdDSA), when ES256 joins additively.

kid.description: The hub key's kid, as the estate record certifies it on one machine (machines[].hubKey.kid).

sig.description: The Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, base64url without padding) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the lease without sig.
